phase1_classification.kind_reason: Contributes 'An execution-grounded benchmark for claim invalidation' for coding-agent memory: 10,369 claims (test functions) with 184 execution-verified flips from 23 Python libraries. It tests whether a stored claim stays true after a commit diff; the paper never mentions sessions or cross-session
